attributes.action: Create a National Grooming and Child Exploitation Taskforce
attributes.additional_details: Major inquiries into Rotherham, Rochdale, Oldham and Telford show repeated failures in policing, safeguarding and intelligence‑sharing. Local systems lack specialist expertise and coordination. A permanent national taskforce is needed to identify networks, support victims consistently and prevent further harm across the UK.
attributes.background: Create a permanent national taskforce to investigate and prevent grooming and child sexual exploitation. Local systems have repeatedly failed. A specialist multi‑agency unit is needed to identify networks, share intelligence and ensure victims receive consistent protection.

rejection.details:
The Child Sexual Exploitation (CSE) Taskforce was launched in 2023. 

You can find out more about the work of the CSE Taskforce here: https://www.hydrantprogramme.co.uk/cse-taskforce

You may also be interested in this statement made on 8 April 2025: https://hansard.parliament.uk/commons/2025-04-08/debates/4FDDC9A4-1AC6-4F34-8E6B-3DF6CC2C981A/TacklingChildSexualAbuse
